description: Check a page's draft: the checklist, what to fix, by name. A page Sightkick wrote is also graded on the four pillars (answers the search, says something new, can be trusted, easy to quote): overall 0 to 100, each pillar's verdict, and for each pillar under 80 what would raise it, 25 per day. A page you or the owner wrote gets the checklist alone, overall null, spending nothing. Write, check, clear the checklist, check again.
name: score_page
title: Score a page
